kebab_example: aliyun apig list-services --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --name user-service --source-type MSE_NACOS --source-types '["K8S","FC3"]' --gateway-id gw-cpv4sqdl00000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxxe5rc6cvla --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServices

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，不填默认1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，有效范围[1, 100]，不填默认10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The service name for exact match query
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The source type of the service. Valid values:

MSE_NACOS: The service is from MSE Nacos.
K8S: The service is from a Kubernetes cluster in Container Service.
FC3: The service is from Function Compute.
VIP: The service is from a fixed address.
DNS: The service is from a domain name
parameters.help_zh:
根据服务来源类型查询, 服务来源：
MSE_NACOS:  来源为MSE Nacos里的服务。
K8S: 来源为容器服务里K8S集群里的服务。
FC3: 来源为函数计算里的服务。
VIP: 来源为固定地址的服务。
DNS: 来源为域名的服务
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The list of service source types
parameters.name: source_types

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud-native API gateway
parameters.name: gateway_id
